name: Tiled 2D Texture Volume Representation
definition: A technique to store 3D volumetric data in a 2D texture by tiling the data laterally (x,y) and along the RGB color channels (representing the z-axis slices).
summary: Tiled 2D Texture Volume Representation stores 3D volumetric data in 2D textures by tiling spatial dimensions and mapping depth to RGB channels, enabling rendering on hardware lacking native 3D texture support.
